briefing: Markets sold off sharply with NASDAQ down 2.6% and the S&P 500 down 1.6%, putting conditions firmly in risk-off territory. No new candidates cleared the screen today, so we're holding all 7 existing positions and sitting on cash rather than forcing a buy into weakness.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: 'Risk-off' describes a market mood where investors sell riskier assets like growth stocks and move toward safer holdings or cash, usually triggered by economic worry or uncertainty. On days like this, a disciplined strategy is to avoid chasing new positions and instead protect existing gains with stop-losses.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「避險情緒」（Risk-Off）是指投資者因經濟憂慮或不確定性而拋售成長股等高風險資產，轉向較安全的資產或現金的市場氛圍。在這樣的日子，紀律性的做法是避免追高買入新倉位，並透過停損機制保護現有持倉的獲利。

market_education.summary_en: Broad-based selling hit growth and tech-heavy names hardest, dragging NASDAQ down 2.6% versus a smaller 1.6% decline in the S&P 500, a pattern typical of risk-off days where investors rotate out of higher-beta stocks first. Without specific headlines available today, the move reads as a broad de-risking session rather than a reaction to a single company event. Days like this are when discipline on position sizing and stop-losses matters most.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日市場全面下跌，科技股及成長股跌幅尤為明顯，納斯達克指數下挫2.6%，跌幅遠超標普500指數的1.6%，呈現典型的「risk-off」（避險）格局，資金從高波動性股票撤出。由於今日未有具體新聞標題可供參考，此次下跌較像是整體性的減碼行動，而非單一事件觸發。這類日子正是考驗持倉規模控制與停損機制紀律的時刻。
